method_summary: This selector uses pivot-based clustering with uncertainty-weighted diversity in early rounds (1–9) for broad coverage, then switches to a minimum-cost bipartite matching on the top-5000 quality candidates in later rounds (10–39) to select k pairs that jointly maximize both uncertainty and feature-space diversity through a distance-minus-quality cost function. The round-based schedule balances exploration early with more precise diverse selection once the model has enough signal.
